articles.title: Saudi Arabia shuts key oil pipeline after drone attack launched from Iraq
articles.description: Iraq removes a military commander and opens investigations into the attack that came from an area bordering Iran.
articles.titleJa: サウジアラビアがイラクからのドローン攻撃を受け主要石油パイプラインを閉鎖
articles.summary: イラクからのドローン攻撃によりサウジアラビアの主要石油パイプラインが閉鎖された。イラクは軍司令官を解任し、国境地域からの攻撃について調査を開始した。

articles.title: A united Ireland would be 'fantastic' says Trump during Irish visit
articles.description: Trump is holding meetings in Dublin before attending the Irish Open golf tournament in Doonbeg, County Clare.
articles.titleJa: トランプ氏、アイルランド訪問中に「統一アイルランドは素晴らしい」と発言
articles.summary: トランプ前大統領はアイルランド訪問中、ダブリンでの会談後、統一アイルランドについて「素晴らしい」と述べた。その後、アイルランドオープンゴルフ大会に出席予定。

articles.title: Ukraine faces 'toughest winter' since Russia's full-scale invasion, UN official tells BBC
articles.description: A senior UN official tells the BBC there is a race against the clock to ensure access to power and water through winter.
articles.titleJa: 国連高官、ウクライナはロシアの本格侵攻以来「最も困難な冬」に直面とBBCに語る
articles.summary: 国連高官はBBCに対し、ウクライナがロシア侵攻後「最も困難な冬」に直面しており、冬期間の電力と水へのアクセス確保が急務だと語った。

articles.title: Death toll from Philippines ferry fire climbs to 35, with dozens still missing
articles.description: Access to the burnt-out boat has been slowed by toxic fumes and lingering heat, the country's coast guard says.
articles.titleJa: フィリピンのフェリー火災、死者35人に増加、数十人が依然行方不明
articles.summary: フィリピンでのフェリー火災による死者数が35人に達し、数十人が依然として行方不明となっている。有毒ガスと熱により救助活動が難航している。

articles.title: 'It's like a dog set loose on us' - fear over Kenya's crackdown on foreign traders
articles.description: The authorities have struggled to contain the fallout, as frightened migrants flee the country.
articles.titleJa: 「犬を放たれたようだ」 - ケニアの外国人業者取り締まりに対する恐怖
articles.summary: ケニアでの外国人業者取り締まりに対し、「犬を放たれたようだ」と恐怖が広がり、恐れた移住者たちが国外に逃亡している。当局は事態収拾に苦慮している。

articles.title: Passenger train derails in France leaving at least 44 injured
articles.description: Local officials say186 passengers were on board the train operating the Rouen-Caen route in Normandy.
articles.titleJa: フランスで旅客列車が脱線、少なくとも44人負傷
articles.summary: フランスのノルマンディー地方で旅客列車が脱線し、少なくとも44人が負傷した。列車には186人の乗客が乗車していた。

articles.title: Record heatwaves in France set to make champagne stronger
articles.description: Winemakers can produce bubbly up to 15% ABV following an unusual harvest that produced sweeter grapes.
articles.titleJa: フランスの記録的な熱波でシャンパンのアルコール度数が上昇へ
articles.summary: フランスでの記録的な熱波により、甘いブドウが収穫され、シャンパンのアルコール度数が最大15%まで上がる可能性がある。

articles.title: Arrest made over the death of black woman found hanged from tree in Mississippi
articles.description: Tasia Fortune's body was found  in the lot of an abandoned home in Mississippi in August.
articles.titleJa: ミシシッピ州で木に吊るされた黒人女性の遺体発見事件で逮捕者
articles.summary: ミシシッピ州で8月に発見された木に吊るされた黒人女性、タシア・フォーチュンさんの遺体事件について、逮捕者が出た。

articles.title: Grammy-winning US rapper Lil Durk acquitted in murder-for-hire trial
articles.description: The Chicago rapper was arrested in 2024 and accused of involvement in a shooting that killed the cousin of rival rapper Quando Rondo.
articles.titleJa: グラミー賞受賞米ラッパー、リル・ダーク氏、殺人依頼裁判で無罪に
articles.summary: グラミー賞受賞ラッパー、リル・ダーク氏が、ライバルラッパーの従兄弟殺害事件に関与したとして告発された殺人依頼裁判で無罪となった。

articles.title: Tragic death of woman who testified against father in notorious mafia murder of mother
articles.description: Denise Cosco testified against the powerful 'Ndrangheta clan and her own father over the murder of her mother in Italy.
articles.titleJa: 悪名高いマフィアによる母親殺害事件で父親に証言した女性の悲劇的な死
articles.summary: イタリアの強力なンドランゲタ・マフィアと実父による母親殺害事件で証言したデニース・コスコ氏が悲劇的な死を遂げた。

articles.title: Bulgaria: Fire at factory making munitions for Ukraine
articles.description: Bulgarian authorities are investigating a fire at a munitions factory for links to an explosion at a similar facility in August. Arms maker EMCO says no human error was involved, as investigators look at sabotage.
articles.titleJa: ブルガリア：ウクライナ向け弾薬工場で火災
articles.summary: ブルガリアの弾薬工場で火災が発生し、当局がサボタージュの可能性を捜査中。ウクライナへの弾薬供給に関連しており、国際的な影響も懸念される。

articles.title: Trump visits Ireland, says unification would be 'fantastic'
articles.description: US President Donald Trump's trip to Ireland to watch a golf tournament has also included meetings with leaders there.
articles.titleJa: トランプ氏がアイルランドを訪問、「統一は素晴らしい」と発言
articles.summary: ドナルド・トランプ元米大統領がアイルランドを訪問し、ゴルフ観戦と指導者との会談を行った。アイルランド統一について「素晴らしい」と発言。

articles.title: Uganda lays 'boy king' Oyo to rest amid succession row
articles.description: A funeral is underway for King Oyo Nyimba, who was crowned in the Tooro Kingdom in 1995 aged just 3. His death at 34 has triggered a dispute over a successor, as rumors abound of possible heirs born out of wedlock.
articles.titleJa: ウガンダで「少年王」オヨの葬儀、後継者争いが勃発
articles.summary: ウガンダのトロ王国で、34歳で死去したオヨ・ニインバ王の葬儀が執り行われた。王位継承を巡る争いが勃発し、庶子に関する噂も広まっている。

articles.title: BRICS summit leaders urge 'maximum restraint' in Middle East
articles.description: The joint declaration at the BRICS 2026 summit expressed 'deep concern' over hostilities in the Middle East. China's President Xi Jinping said the Iran war was not in the bloc's interest. Follow DW for more.
articles.titleJa: BRICS首脳会議、中東での「最大限の自制」を要請
articles.summary: BRICS首脳会議で、中東での敵対行為に「深い懸念」が表明され、習近平国家主席はイラン戦争はブロックの利益にならないと発言。国際情勢に影響を与える。

articles.title: Russian GRU spies behind failed Leipzig attack: reports
articles.description: A German newspaper has cited reports tying a failed attack at Leipzig Airport to Moscow's GRU military intelligence agency. One suspect's ties to GRU were known when he entered the country, yet he was not surveilled.
articles.titleJa: ロシアGRUのスパイがライプツィヒ攻撃未遂の背後に：報道
articles.summary: ドイツで、ライプツィヒ空港攻撃未遂にロシアGRUが関与か。容疑者のGRUとの関係は既知でも監視されず、国家安全保障上の問題が浮上。

articles.title: Brazil: Flavio Bolsonaro faces corruption probe weeks before election
articles.description: Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, Lula's top rival in next month's election, is under investigation for alleged corruption linked to financing a biopic about his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro.
articles.titleJa: ブラジル：フラビオ・ボルソナーロ氏、選挙数週間前に汚職捜査直面
articles.summary: ブラジル上院議員ボルソナーロ氏が父親の伝記映画資金に関する汚職疑惑で捜査。次期選挙を数週間後に控え、政局に大きな影響を与える見込み。

articles.title: Corals as climate archive: Are El Ninos intensifying?
articles.description: Records from the past few decades show that, during this period, El Nino events have been frequent and often extreme. But is this normal, or is it the result of climate change? Corals can give us a clear indication.
articles.titleJa: サンゴが気候の記録：エルニーニョは激化しているか？
articles.summary: 過去数十年間でエルニーニョ現象が頻繁かつ極端になっているが、これが気候変動の結果かサンゴが解明の鍵を握る。地球規模の環境問題。

articles.title: Uber leaves two key African markets — and their drivers in despair
articles.description: Uber's departure from Nigeria and Uganda has left countless customers high and dry. But what about drivers? With fuel prices, maintenance, and other operating costs rising, many say they're struggling to make a living.
articles.titleJa: Uberがアフリカの主要2市場から撤退 — ドライバーは絶望
articles.summary: Uberがナイジェリアとウガンダから撤退し、多くの利用者とドライバーに影響。燃料費高騰など運営コスト増で、ドライバーは生活に苦しんでいる。

articles.title: North Korea fires multiple ballistic missiles day after trilateral drills end
articles.description: North Korea launched several short-range ballistic missiles into the sea a day after the US, South Korea and Japan concluded joint military exercises Pyongyang had called provocative.
articles.titleJa: 北朝鮮、三国間演習終了翌日に弾道ミサイルを複数発射
articles.summary: 北朝鮮が、米韓日合同軍事演習終了の翌日に短距離弾道ミサイルを複数発射。地域間の緊張を高める挑発行為と見られている。

articles.title: Russia's drone war comes to Moldova and Romania
articles.description: Incursions by Russian drones into Moldovan and Romanian airspace are increasingly common. This week the Ukrainian president's plane was stopped from taking off from Chisinau. Observers suspect the attacks are deliberate.
articles.titleJa: ロシアのドローン攻撃がモルドバとルーマニアに及ぶ
articles.summary: ロシアのドローンがモルドバとルーマニア領空に頻繁に侵入し、ウクライナ大統領機の離陸も阻止。意図的な攻撃と見られ、地域情勢は緊迫している。

articles.title: $15m fund launched to create ‘unstoppable momentum’ to end FGM worldwide
articles.description:
Her Horizon Fund seeks $100m to stop practice harming 230m women and girls globally  
Frontline activists and leaders in the fight against female genital mutilation, which has affected more than 230 million women and girls worldwide, have welcomed an unprecedented $15.5m (£11.4m) fund aimed at creating “unstoppable momentum” to finally end the practice.
The launch of the fund comes as women’s rights are increasingly under attack and donor funding is in sharp decline, particularly for work led by FGM survivors in local communities. It is thought to be the largest single philanthropic contribution to ending the practice of FGM.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: FGM（女性器切除）を世界中で終わらせる『止められない勢い』を生み出すため、1500万ドルの基金が立ち上げられた
articles.summary: 世界中で2億3000万人以上の女性と少女に影響を与えるFGM根絶へ向け、1550万ドルの基金が発足。女性の権利が脅かされ、支援資金が減少する中、この慣習を終わらせるための最大の慈善貢献とみられている。

articles.title: Secret son revelation ignites bitter succession dispute in Ugandan kingdom
articles.description:
Family of late King Oyo Nyimba Kabamba Iguru Rukidi IV reject committee’s choice of cousin and TV presenter as new monarch
A traditional Ugandan kingdom has become engulfed in a bitter succession dispute after the family of a king who recently died rejected the selection of a television news anchor as his successor.
King Oyo Nyimba Kabamba Iguru Rukidi IV, who became the world’s youngest reigning monarch when he took the throne in the kingdom of Tooro in 1995 at the age of three, died on 27 August in the US, where he was receiving cancer treatment.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 秘密の息子発覚がウガンダ王国の激しい継承争いに火をつける
articles.summary: ウガンダの伝統的な王国で、故オヨ・ニンバ・カバンバ・イグル・ルキディ4世の家族が、テレビ司会者である従兄弟の次の君主選出を拒否し、激しい継承争いが勃発。秘密の息子が明らかになったことで事態はさらに複雑化している。

articles.title: Uganda to withdraw from Invictus Games ‘out of respect for King Charles’, says military chief
articles.description:
Gen Muhoozi Kainerugaba announces decision to pull out in post on X, citing tensions over ‘Harry-Meghan nonsense’
Uganda is withdrawing from the Duke of Sussex’s Invictus Games, the country’s military chief has said, out of respect for King Charles amid division over the “Harry-Meghan nonsense”.
Gen Muhoozi Kainerugaba, son of the Ugandan president, made the surprise announcement in a post on X on Wednesday.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ウガンダ、チャールズ国王への敬意を表しインヴィクタス・ゲームからの撤退を発表、軍司令官が表明
articles.summary: ウガンダ軍司令官が、チャールズ国王への敬意と「ハリーとメーガンの騒動」を巡る緊張を理由に、インヴィクタス・ゲームからの撤退をXで発表した。

articles.title: Babies born to anaemic mothers have smaller brains, study finds
articles.description:
Key regions of the brain linked to movement, learning and emotions were affected and may lead to cognitive problems 
Babies born to mothers with anaemia have smaller brains, particularly in key regions linked to movement, learning and the regulation of emotion, according to a study.
Researchers said the differences, first detected at the age of one, could lead to cognitive problems when children started school.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 貧血の母親から生まれた赤ちゃんは脳が小さいことが研究で判明
articles.summary: 貧血の母親から生まれた赤ちゃんは、運動、学習、感情に関連する脳の主要領域が小さいことが研究で示された。1歳で検出されるこの違いは、就学時に認知問題につながる可能性がある。

articles.title: Hijacking pirates exploit regional chaos to return to seas off Somalia
articles.description:
US-Israel war on Iran and political instability in Somalia lead to pirates targeting cargo ships off Horn of Africa
The scourge of Somali piracy targeting cargo ships and smaller dhows off the Horn of Africa has returned to levels not seen in a decade, driven by a convergence of factors including disruptions to the shipping industry caused by the US-Israeli war against Iran and a resurgence of political instability in Somalia.
Since late April there have been eight hijackings by Somali pirates, including two within the space of a fortnight in August: one targeting an oil tanker with ties to Iran, the other a Cameroon-flagged vessel, the Lutuf, carrying military equipment for Turkey.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 海賊が地域の混乱を悪用しソマリア沖に再来
articles.summary: 米・イスラエル対イランの戦争とソマリアの政治的不安定を背景に、ソマリア沖での海賊行為が10年ぶりの水準に増加。貨物船を標的としたハイジャックが多発しており、アフリカの角地域の海上安全保障が深刻化している。

articles.title: Canada offers air defense support for Ukraine as Zelenskyy visits
articles.description:
Canadian PM Mark Carney hosts president in Calgary, where he grew up alongside large Ukrainian community
Canada offered support on Thursday to boost Ukraine’s air defenses and help replenish its drone stocks, as the countries pledged to deepen their alliance during a visit by Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
Mark Carney hosted the president of Ukraine in Calgary in the western province of Alberta, where the Canadian prime minister grew up among a large community of people with Ukrainian heritage.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ゼレンスキー大統領訪問時、カナダがウクライナへの防空支援を申し出
articles.summary: ゼレンスキー大統領のカナダ訪問中に、カナダはウクライナの防空能力強化とドローン在庫補充のための支援を申し出た。両国は同盟を深めることを誓い、カナダ首相がカルガリーで大統領を歓迎した。

articles.title: Rubio signals shift to working with allies to fight drug trade as latest boat strike kills three
articles.description:
Rubio visits Ecuador and welcomes cooperation after campaign of unilateral strikes on alleged ‘narco-terrorists’
The US secretary of state, Marco Rubio, gave new clarity on the approach toward combating drug trafficking in Latin American waters, saying the Trump administration was focused on working with allied countries and aligning with their laws but insisted the military would “still blow up ships if need be”.
The public acknowledgment of a shift in US strategy comes a year after Washington began a campaign of unilateral deadly strikes against those it calls “narco-terrorists” operating boats in international waters.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 最新のボート攻撃で3人死亡、ルビオ国務長官が麻薬取引対策で同盟国との連携へ転換を示唆
articles.summary: 米国務長官マルコ・ルビオが、ラテンアメリカの麻薬密売対策において、同盟国との連携を強化する方針転換を示唆した。一方的な攻撃のキャンペーン後、エクアドルを訪問し、協力体制を歓迎する意向を表明した。

articles.title: Notorious Ecuadorian crime gang designated a terrorist group by US
articles.description:
Trump administration to seek extra funding from Congress to ‘dismantle’ Los Tiguerones over narcotics trafficking
The US has designated Ecuador’s Los Tiguerones gang, which stormed a television station during a live broadcast in 2024, as a terrorist organisation as the Trump administration expands its campaign against narcotics traffickers it says are destabilising Latin America.
The US secretary of state, Marco Rubio, made the announcement in Quito, where he met Ecuadorian president Daniel Noboa, one of several rightwing allies of Donald Trump whom Rubio is courting as a security partner during a three-nation tour through Latin America that began on Tuesday.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 米、悪名高いエクアドルの犯罪組織をテロ集団に指定
articles.summary: 米国は、エクアドルの悪名高い犯罪組織「ロス・ティゲロネス」をテロ組織に指定した。トランプ政権は麻薬密売人対策のキャンペーンを拡大しており、米国務長官マルコ・ルビオがキトでこの発表を行った。

articles.title: Family of British man found dead in Grenada ask local police to work with UK investigators
articles.description:
Andrew Frederick’s body was found in property he was staying at in Grenada in January
The family of a British father who was found dead in the Caribbean in January is urging authorities in Grenada to work with UK police to uncover the truth about his death.
Andrew Frederick’s body was found in the property he was staying at in Grenada on 4 January. An autopsy, performed in the same week by a privately hired pathologist, concluded that the 47-year-old’s death was a homicide.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: グレナダで死亡した英国人男性の家族、現地警察に英国捜査官との協力を要請
articles.summary: 1月にグレナダで遺体で発見された英国人アンドリュー・フレデリックさんの家族が、グレナダ当局に対し、英国警察と協力して彼の死の真相を究明するよう求めている。検視の結果、死因は殺人であると結論付けられている。

articles.title: ‘It’s hell’: father of slain Australian surfers tells Mexico homicide trial about identifying sons’ bodies
articles.description:
Three men are on trial over the death of brothers Jake and Callum Robinson and their friend, US citizen Jack Carter Rhoad, in Ensenada
The father of two Australian surfers killed in Mexico two years ago testified in court on Tuesday that his life had been turned into hell, as the high-profile trial continued into its second day.
Three men are charged in the killing of Australian brothers Jake and Callum Robinson, aged 30 and 33, respectively, and their 30-year-old American friend Jack Carter Rhoad, who were on a surfing trip to Mexico’s Pacific coast in April 2024.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 「地獄だ」：殺害された豪人サーファーの父親、メキシコ殺人裁判で息子たちの遺体確認について語る
articles.summary: メキシコで殺害されたオーストラリア人サーファー2人の父親が、高名な殺人裁判で息子たちの遺体を確認した際の「地獄のような」体験を証言した。3人の男が兄弟と米国人友人の殺害容疑で裁判にかけられている。

articles.title: At least 11 killed in Russian attacks on Ukraine as Kyiv strikes Russia's 'shadow fleet'
articles.description: The strikes hit several regions, with Odesa suffering particularly badly. At the same time, Kyiv is pursuing an operation against Russia's "shadow fleet", aiming to choke off a key source of war funding
articles.titleJa: ロシアのウクライナ攻撃で少なくとも11人死亡、キーウはロシアの「影の艦隊」を攻撃
articles.summary: ロシアによるウクライナ複数地域への攻撃で少なくとも11人が死亡。同時にキーウはロシアの「影の艦隊」への作戦を展開し、戦費源を断つことを目指している。

articles.title: German police bodycam captures dramatic arrest of suspected power saboteur
articles.description: Police in North Rhine-Westphalia have released bodycam footage showing the arrest of alleged power saboteur Daniel V., with officers drawing their weapons as new details emerge in the case.
articles.titleJa: ドイツ警察のボディカムが電力破壊工作容疑者の劇的な逮捕を捉える
articles.summary: ノルトライン＝ヴェストファーレン州警察は、電力破壊工作容疑者ダニエル・V.の逮捕時のボディカム映像を公開。警官が武器を構える様子が映っており、事件の新たな詳細が明らかに。

articles.title: Moment teen is rescued after three days adrift in frigid waters
articles.description: A 15-year-old boy was rescued after clinging to an overturned boat for nearly three days in the frigid Bering Sea off Alaska.
articles.titleJa: 極寒の海を3日間漂流後、ティーンが救助された瞬間
articles.summary: アラスカ沖のベーリング海で、転覆したボートにしがみついて3日間近く漂流していた15歳の少年が無事に救助された。

articles.title: Welcome to Riga and the Baltic military-industrial complex
articles.description: Good morning. Angela Skujins penning this Friday newsletter from the bitter Baltics, where I’ve just spent the last few days immersed in beetroot soup, battlefield tactics and the scintillating spirit of the rīdzinieki, aka Rigan people.
articles.titleJa: リガとバルト諸国の軍事産業複合体へようこそ
articles.summary: リガとバルト諸国の軍事産業複合体に焦点を当てたニュースレター。執筆者はリガでの体験を通じて、地域の戦略的重要性を伝える。

articles.title: Diesel in Portugal hits record high, Spain introduces new discount
articles.description: Many Portuguese already cross the border to fill up; the trend is now even clearer, as Spain's government adds a 20-cent-per-litre discount, making Spanish diesel the second cheapest in the EU.
articles.titleJa: ポルトガルでディーゼル価格が過去最高を記録、スペインは新たな割引を導入
articles.summary: ポルトガルでディーゼル価格が過去最高値を記録。これを受け、給油のため国境を越えるポルトガル人が増加し、スペイン政府は1リットルあたり20セントの割引を導入した。

articles.title: 3D-printed food: from niche technology to a potential future
articles.description: 3D printers can now transform more than two dozen types of food into edible shapes. While the technology remains costly and impractical for everyday use, experts see significant potential in clinics, care homes and personalised nutrition.
articles.titleJa: 3Dプリント食品：ニッチな技術から潜在的な未来へ

articles.title: Goods barometer points to resilient trade growth despite headwinds

articles.title: WTO issues 2026 Annual Report
articles.description: The WTO published today (9 September) its 2026 Annual Report, providing a comprehensive account of the organization’s activities in 2025 and the early part of 2026. The Report looks back at recent key events, such as the 14th Ministerial Conference in March 2026, and describes the WTO's work in addressing the challenges and opportunities facing world trade.
articles.titleJa: WTOが2026年年次報告書を発表

articles.title: New report highlights growth potential of digital trade in Latin America, Caribbean

articles.titleJa: 新報告書がラテンアメリカ・カリブ海地域のデジタル貿易の成長潜在力を強調

articles.title: Madagascar Launches Safeguard Investigation on Certain Types of Rice

articles.titleJa: マダガスカルが特定の米に対するセーフガード調査を開始

articles.title: Trade finance: how volatile financial conditions influence its availability and impact trade levels
articles.description: Global trade opens opportunities for economic growth. However, moving goods across borders, between exporters and importers, involves counterparty risk such as payment and liquidity risk. Trade finance facilitates trade by mitigating these risks.Using a new dataset, we find that volatile global financial conditions constrict the availability of trade finance, especially in emerging markets and developing countries. In addition, the level of development of local financial markets influences the supply of trade finance by global institutions.
articles.titleJa: 貿易金融：変動する金融情勢がその利用可能性と貿易水準にどう影響するか

articles.title: WTO concludes advanced workshop on agriculture notifications
articles.description: Twenty-nine government officials from developing and least-developed WTO members participated in the 2026 edition of the Advanced Workshop on Agriculture Notifications, held at the WTO from 1 to 4 September. The workshop seeks to enhance members' understanding of transparency requirements under the Agreement on Agriculture and supports their efforts to meet notification obligations.
articles.titleJa: WTOが農業通報に関する上級ワークショップを終了

articles.title: Public Forum 2026 programme is now available

articles.title: WTO members adopt panel report regarding EU duties on fatty acid from Indonesia

articles.title: Madagascar launches safeguard investigation on self-adhesive labels, packaging and certain other printed items
articles.description: On 28 August 2026, Madagascar notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated on 13 August 2026 a safeguard investigation on imports of self-adhesive labels, packaging and other printed items on paper, cardboard, plastics, textiles or other similar materials.
articles.titleJa: マダガスカルが粘着ラベル、包装材、その他印刷物に対するセーフガード調査を開始
articles.summary: マダガスカルは、粘着ラベル、包装材、その他印刷物の輸入に対するセーフガード調査を2026年8月13日に開始したことをWTOに通知しました。

articles.title: Deadline to register for 2026 Public Forum is 21 August
articles.description: The deadline for online registration for this year’s in-person Public Forum, which will take place on 15, 16 and 17 September, is 21 August 2026 (23.59 CET). Late and onsite registrations will not be accepted.
articles.titleJa: 2026年パブリック・フォーラムの登録締め切りは8月21日
articles.summary: 9月15日から17日まで開催される対面式パブリック・フォーラムのオンライン登録締め切りは、2026年8月21日（中央ヨーロッパ時間23:59）です。
